description: Connect the person’s own Roblox games to RoTerminal, so my_games, my_game_numbers and the rest read Roblox’s own analytics for them (visits, earnings, where players come from, retention). Only the person can do it, on Roblox’s own screen: this gives the link to open, and which of their games are connected now. Never ask them for a Roblox API key, cookie or password.

game.description: One of their games to land back on once it’s connected (optional)

name: connect_game
title: Connect your games
